image_prompt: Bill is a diminutive, vaguely humanoid figure with a portly, rotund physique. His rounded, cherubic features are framed by a tousle of wild, unruly hair the color of burnished copper. Wearing a tattered, oversized Victorian-style frock coat and waistcoat, with mismatched stockings and boots, Bill's appearance is one of haphazard, whimsical disarray. His wide, expressive eyes glimmer with a mischievous, almost feral intelligence, and his mouth is twisted into a sly, crooked grin, revealing a mouthful of crooked, jagged teeth. Despite his small stature, Bill carries himself with an air of impish confidence, suggesting a character who is equal parts endearing and unsettling.
chapter_references: CHAPTER IV. The Rabbit Sends in a Little Bill
